text: child-page originally had no web app manifest, icons or service worker, so Chrome 'install' on Android only created a broken shortcut; installability/offline is tracked as a separate feature issue.

child-page originally required 'no data stored'; features needing persistence (e.g. playtime timer) must explicitly relax that rule for minimal local-only storage and define a parent gate for any parent-facing Settings.
child-page playtime limit design: timer counts only visible activity time, resets automatically each new day, and stores only the limit and time used locally (relaxing the 'no data stored' rule).
child-page review feedback is batched into one issue for polish items, with fixes that depend on an unmerged feature PR (e.g. playtime moon-screen fade) split into their own dependent issue.
child-page Settings (sum gate, limit form, timer reset) lives in js/playtime.js with panes gate-pane/settings-pane in index.html; new parent configuration sections belong behind the same gate.
